params.prompt: A single continuous 15-second cinematic documentary dramatization, landscape 16:9, natural real-time movement. In a modest independent business office on a cloudy weekday, a business owner, woman about 58 with short dark brown hair streaked with gray, wearing a navy cardigan and cream blouse, sits on the RIGHT side of a plain pale oak meeting table. A potential buyer, man about 43 with cropped dark hair, wearing a charcoal open-collar shirt, sits on the LEFT. Quiet warm off-white walls, one frosted-glass partition behind the woman, side daylight from frame left. One thin closed dark green folder lies between them, two plain water glasses stay still at the table edges. Medium-wide two-shot, eye level, locked tripod, natural 50mm perspective. The one action: the buyer finishes studying the papers inside the folder, closes it gently, and brings his attention to the owner; she meets his gaze with the practiced ease of someone who knows this business. Measured natural rapport, no grand gestures. Leave two seconds of quiet lead-in and a long usable listening hold after the folder closes. The audience should feel a consequential ordinary meeting, not an advertisement. No camera movement, cuts, montage, zoom, slow motion, music, subtitles, logos, readable numbers or invented document text. Do not make either character address camera. Keep left-right positions, wardrobe, props and room fixed. Any conversational mouth movement is incidental illustrative acting; no spoken words are requested. Final image: closed folder between buyer and owner, reciprocal eyelines, buyer ready to ask a practical question.

Animate this exact approved portrait into a natural direct-to-camera presenter. Preserve the man's identity, face shape, age, hair, facial hair, complexion, wardrobe, background, lighting, lens and framing. Locked camera. He delivers the supplied audio reference exactly, synchronized to its words, pacing, pauses and voice. Do not rewrite, paraphrase, speed up, add or omit any words. The supplied reference starts immediately and runs 11.34 seconds; leave the remaining tail as a quiet closed-mouth hold. Relaxed still torso, subtle natural head movement only, comfortable eye contact with the lens, natural blinks, restrained mouth opening with ordinary readable articulation. No emphatic nodding, head swaying, grin, repetitive gestures, big body motions or added hand gestures. No camera movement, cuts, background movement, music, ambient audio, subtitles, graphic overlays or logos. This is a calm operator explaining his show, not an enthusiastic commercial. Exact words for disambiguation only: This is The Operator Economy, where we show you how to use AI to build, own, and operate a sustainable business of one. Today we are building a sale readiness practice.

Correct ONLY the meeting staging and camera coverage of this film still, preserving exactly the two people's identities, faces, clothes, age, plain small-business back office, pale wood table, dark green folder, glasses and soft ordinary daylight. This is a business buyer meeting a female owner ACROSS the table, never sitting next to her. View the rectangular table from one short end at a diagonal: the man is seated on the LEFT long side, in the left third of image in three-quarter profile facing RIGHT; the woman sits OPPOSITE on the RIGHT long side, in right third of image in three-quarter profile facing LEFT. A clear open tabletop separates their two bodies across the entire center. Their knees and chairs are on opposite sides; both lean very slightly toward the middle. The green closed folder rests on the table center between them. The man has one hand lightly resting near the folder and the woman has hands resting on the table edge nearest her. Genuine reciprocal eyelines across the table. Modest small office, no luxury boardroom. Medium wide two shot, stable eye-level camera, no dramatic angle. Neutral comfortable attention, neither anxious nor celebrating. Do not include two views, split screen, reference collage, captions, labels, logos, text or numbers. Full-bleed horizontal 16:9 single photographic frame.

Photorealistic film still of a quiet acquisition meeting in a modest small-business back office, overcast daylight, ordinary off-white walls and a frosted-glass partition. A rectangular pale oak table runs AWAY from the camera into the room: its SHORT END is at the bottom center of the image, and its two LONG EDGES recede toward the back wall. Two people sit DIRECTLY OPPOSITE EACH OTHER on those two long edges. Man on the LEFT EDGE in profile facing RIGHT; woman on the RIGHT EDGE in profile facing LEFT. Their chairs are OUTSIDE opposite long edges, and a broad empty tabletop visibly separates their torsos. Camera is high at the short end, looking diagonally DOWN over the whole table, both chairs and seated bodies visible to knees; NOT a front view of two people seated along one edge. Buyer: 43-year-old man with short cropped dark hair, charcoal open-collar shirt. Owner: 58-year-old woman with short brown hair streaked gray, navy cardigan over cream blouse. They look at each other with quiet, comfortable professional attention; the buyer is curious, the owner confident. One closed dark green folder centered between them and one plain water glass near each person's elbow. No other people. Their hands rest on their OWN nearest table edge. Natural lens perspective, cinematic realism without glossy corporate styling. No text, figures, logos or subtitles; no split-screen or collage. Single landscape16:9 frame. The most important requirement is unmistakable seating ON OPPOSITE SIDES of the table.

Keep actions small and ordinary; no anxiety yet. Give the interaction time, then let both rest in attentive stillness. The folder stays closed and centered. Fixed tripod, no camera motion, no cut, no slow motion. No speech, no audible dialogue, no music, no captions, no new objects, no readable text. Do not change sides or turn toward camera. Ending: both are settled and the buyer is about to ask a practical question.
